figurative_meaning_en: to apply oneself diligently; to become attentive and engaged
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাজে গা লাগিয়ে দাও, তাহলে সব হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Buckle down to the task, and everything will get done.
You need to apply yourself to preparing for the exam.
note: This idiom emphasizes physical and mental commitment to tasks, common in motivational contexts.
